text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san. You are departing already, 
I take it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes... Ardan-san, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Have a safe trip... ......

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...You must not lose.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have no intention of doing so. I 
will be heading over with that exact 
mindset.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"—The Japan Cup. Held at Tokyo Racecourse. 
A medium-distance 2,400m turf race."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A race on the world stage where 
international stars gather every year, 
whipping all of Japan into a frenzy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"However, today—just for this once. That 
world will belong to us."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The venue is Tokyo Racecourse. A 
2,400-meter turf medium-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, this is the Classic distance. ...The 
exact same distance as that race."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... This is the first time I've ever 
watched Maruzensky race in person...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"No, seriously, you're gonna be shocked! 
Plus, this time she's up against Tenno Sho 
Autumn's Chiyono O, right? I wonder who's 
gonna win!"

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
We have an extremely large turnout today! 
Please do not push and proceed slowly! 
Move forward at a slow, steady pace!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This race is a matchup everyone 
wants to see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
On one side, an Umamusume who dealt a blow 
to the "Eternal Big Three." On the other, 
an Umamusume hailed as a "Legend," who 
many thought would never return.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: How intriguing... truly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Whew...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.
choice_data_list: Looks like your focus is spot-on.
Looks like your focus is spot-on, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have no hesitations whatsoever. 
Having come this far, my feelings are set 
on one thing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm going to reach for the stars, I'd 
rather have victories than defeats."
choice_data_list: We'll seize victory, no matter what

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. 'Chiyo is the pot, Trainer is 
the ladle', remember?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
During the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I heard 
your voice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because that voice was what gave me 
that final push.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...So, Trainer. Um...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Will you support my back again when I run? 
So that I can keep running, wherever that 
may be.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I'm counting on you!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"—Open this door, and take the underground 
tunnel."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I just head toward that bright, radiant 
light—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Maruzen-san! 
How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Everything's hunky-dory♪ Chiyo-chaaan♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“I'm sorry, though. My engine's already 
running at full throttle... I don't think 
I can hold back on you now.”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So just behave and let yourself be eaten 
by the monster, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I cannot do that. Because I am the 
one who will be devouring you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us enjoy this together. A 
once-in-a-lifetime race for you and me...

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Maruzen
text_block_list.text: —A Derby for the two of them.
